hypotheses.name: Worming persistence as emission reliability + head feature (owner-mandated)
layers: training_features band 2 rtp (magnetic, reduced to pole)
hypotheses.signature: Fourier upward-continuation ladder 0/100/200/400/800/1600 m; local maxima of horizontal-gradient modulus per level; cross-level worm tracking with height-growing match tolerance; persistence P and amplitude-retention S rasters; joint = min over fields.
hypotheses.why_unmapped: Deep-rooted basement fabric feeding geothermal fluid keeps a coherent gradient edge up to km of continuation; shallow artifacts (acquisition lineation, near-surface conductors, cultural noise) die at the first continuation steps. Catalogue-missing faults under thin cover have no scarp but do keep a potential-field discontinuity.
hypotheses.differs: 19GEMSDOE L4 used a SINGLE fixed 1.5 km strike-coherent gradient (no ladder, no survival). GEMSDOE26 XEDGE / 27 H28-1 used Gaussian scale-space ratios as head features only. Here: true UC (depth-interpretable, Horowitz 2018), explicit survival + vanishing statistics, used as an emission gate (A1), an emission re-ranker (A2) AND a head feature (B1).
hypotheses.cost: 1 day (implemented); ladder pass measured 49 s on 2 cores
hypotheses.gates: A1-A0, A2-A0, B1-B0 frozen gate knowledge/01 §5
hypotheses.status_after_2026_10_03: Corrected two-screen run: A1/A2/B1 each FAIL the +0.005 screen. Pre-correction receipts are invalid due P normalization defect and preserved under evidence/history; no confirmation run for corrected screen failures.

hypotheses.name: Residualized 2 m thermal probes as independent far-field corroboration
layers: GDR 1391 INGENIOUS 2 m probe shapefile (hash-pinned 1301f70d...), F2mDAB background-normalized anomaly
hypotheses.signature: Nearest-probe distance + F2mDAB anomaly surfaces; in an amagmatic extensional province a thermal anomaly without a mapped structure raises the prior for an unmapped permeable fault (Siler & Faulds).
hypotheses.why_unmapped: Probes were sited by field crews for thermal effect, not by mapping convenience; anomalous F2mDAB away from catalogue traces is evidence of a pathway the USGS/INGENIOUS maps lack.
hypotheses.differs: GEMSDOE25's H27-2 was BLOCKED: the binary could not be fetched. The bytes are verified locally for the first time this session. No prior repo rasterised F2mDAB onto the competition grid.
hypotheses.status_after_2026_10_03: Corrected B2 two-screen mean deltas +0.000497/+0.001232, below +0.005; FAIL, no confirmation. Catalogue-proxy only.

hypotheses.name: Acquisition-line notch before worming
layers: rtp spectrum; GeoDAWN flight geometry: 4 blocks, E-W lines, 200/400 m spacing
hypotheses.signature: Spectral notch at cross-line frequencies 1/200,1/400 m^-1, then re-run the worming ladder; candidates whose edges only exist pre-notch are line-aliasing.
hypotheses.why_unmapped: Suppressing aliasing sharpens sub-parallel basement edges that catalogue mapping skipped because survey artifacts masked them.
hypotheses.differs: IR-29-LINE-PERSISTENCE-INVERSION: raw persistence does NOT preferentially kill E-W edges on this grid (E-W most persistent: 0.656 vs 0.562), so a notch is the only clean way to test line-removal; no sibling repo ever computed the line spectrum.
hypotheses.gates: NOT gated this session — preregistration §5 covers only arms run; registers for next session with its own gate.

hypotheses.name: Earthquake-density + strain-invariant coherence as active-fault prior
layers: bands 4 geod_2ndinv, 7 geod_shearrate, 8 geod_dilatationrate, 10 deq_n100a15, 16 ieq_n100a15
hypotheses.signature: Coherence of microseismicity density with dilatation maxima along persistent (worming-selected) basement lineaments.
hypotheses.why_unmapped: Slip below scarp-forming threshold keeps faults active-but-unmapped; seismicity is instrumented, scarps are visual.
hypotheses.differs: GEMSDOE26 DILCOND used dilatation x conductivity coincidence only; no repo coupled the strain/earthquake family THROUGH a persistence-selected corridor.
hypotheses.cost: 1 day; needs H29-1 output as input
